description:
What a layout on a floor assumed from the listing's stated area is (DesignVersion.floor_estimate).

Never present on a layout solved on a measured, CAD, owner-measured, photo or fixture floor.

area_measured.description: Always false: the area is the listing's stated figure, not a measurement.
area_measured.title: Area Measured

assumed_shape.description: e.g. 'rectangle 3:2, one entrance mid short side'.
assumed_shape.title: Assumed Shape

listed_area.description: The listing's stated area, as stored.
listed_area.title: Listed Area

listed_area_unit.description: Unit of listed_area as stored ('sqm': CommercialListing.available_area_sqm).
listed_area_unit.title: Listed Area Unit

shape_assumed.description: Always true: the floor's shape is an assumption.
shape_assumed.title: Shape Assumed

shows.description: What the sketch can and cannot show, in plain words.
shows.title: Shows

unknown.description: What is not known about the real floor, e.g. 'columns', 'fixed_walls', 'plumbing'.
unknown.title: Unknown

title: FloorEstimate
